name: Scroll Highlight
description: Article-style page where selected phrases get a marker-style highlight that sweeps in as they scroll into view, each with its own hue, over a faded grid backdrop.
contents: Sections list with a title and paragraphs or bullet lists
Inline highlighted phrases with individual hues
Fixed grid overlay behind the content
behavior: Highlight sweeps across a phrase when 80% of it is visible and retracts when it leaves
Grid overlay stays fixed and fades toward the top left
editableByProps: All section titles, paragraphs, lists and highlighted phrases with their hues
Background and text colors, grid visibility, size and opacity, content width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change highlight saturation, lightness or trigger point
needsCodeEdit.where: color constant and threshold option inside the Mark function
transition style inside the Mark function

fixed: Grid overlay is position fixed over the whole viewport behind the content
First section title renders as the h1, the rest as h2
Includes bottom padding of 30vmin below the content
